messages.subject: Setting ylim(1,x)
parts:
Hi there, would it be possible to somehow set the limits of an axis to just the minimum value, and leave the maximum open? I could imagine how to set the maximum to the maximum value in my data, but I generally like the nice rounding up that ggplot is doing, so I would like to keep that.. Problem is that lots of my data is in the 1..X range, but I want the y axis to still start at 0, which sometimes it does not..

Thanks a lot in advance!

Cheers,
Martin
